plan.title: Reject surrogate bid with rebid allowed

steps.note: the API built this case's state
Enable the eRFX project capability required by the case.
Navigate to the RFQ Responses view containing Vendor A’s surrogate bid.
Confirm the rejection control is available for Vendor A’s bid.

args.text: Are you sure you want to reject this bid by Vendor A

steps.note: Verify the dialog identifies the correct vendor and rejection action.
Enable the seller rebid option required by the case.
Verify the rejection reason is visible after confirmation.
Open the rejected-bids list from the RFQ stage menu.

args.text: Rejection Remark: Price not valid — QA

steps.note: Verify the rejected-bids list contains the required remark.
Switch to Vendor A’s supplier-portal session to inspect the vendor-side result.
Open the event’s pricing round in the vendor portal.
Check that Vendor A can see the rejection reason in the supplier portal.
Return to the buyer’s event page for the ranking check.
Open the comparison grid after rejection.
Verify Vendor B is shown as the leading remaining bid.
